h1: WaterSound "The Crossings, Unit 110C" 100 South Bridge Lane 110C
description_expanded: HOME HIGHLIGHTS:- Gated Community with on-site Security- Private deeded beach access- Gulf views- Fantastic porch spaces- Pool and beach are just yards away- Community fitness center and parks- Garage- From March 1st to October 31st, the rental of this property includes one beach -service set (2 beach chairs and 1 umbrella)- Complete Clean Linen Participant - ALL linens, including comforter covers, are laundered upon every checkout*This property comes with 1 dedicated parking space in the driveway, and 1 first-come, first-served parking space within the community. Please note that first-come, first-served parking is limited and not guaranteed. This home permits a maximum of 2 vehicles through the community security gate.*Beginning in March 2025 and continuing through 2026, the WaterSound Crossings condominiums will undergo an extensive exterior refurbishment project. During this period, residents and guests should expect significant construction activity, including the boarding of windows and restricted access to balconies in affected buildings. These measures are necessary to ensure safety and facilitate the successful completion of the work.DETAILS: Additional details coming soon!SLEEPING ARRANGEMENTS: (Sleeps 8):FIRST FLOOR:- Primary Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower/Tub Separate- Additional Sleeping Area: Twin-over-Twin Bunk BedSECOND FLOOR:- Guest Bedroom: Queen Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower/Tub Combo- Guest Bedroom: 2 Twin Beds, Private Bathroom with Shower Only*Weddings or parties/groups of people or guests of guests are not allowed at this home. If this policy is violated, you may be asked to vacate the property and forfeit any rental payments and be subject to HOA, community, and 360 Blue fines.*We are happy to welcome up to 2 dogs for an additional non-refundable pet fee of $400, plus tax.
